## Controller 1.0.51 (67)
- New: Connect Repositories. A checkout can now link to a repository stored in your Controller Connect account and sync with Push to Connect / Fetch from Connect in Git Actions, so work lands even while another Mac sleeps. GitHub remains mirrored and keeps pull request review. - Agents can do the same from inside a turn with the new `connect_repos`, `connect_repo_status`, `connect_repo_create`, `connect_repo_link`, `connect_repo_unlink`, `connect_repo_push` and `connect_repo_fetch` tools. - Sync is compare-and-swap: divergence is reported with the current Connect head instead of forced, fetches fast-forward only a clean checked-out branch, and a checkout's link lives in Git config (`connect.repoId`) rather than as a fake `git` remote. - Encrypted repositories can be created today; syncing them arrives with key management in a later release.

## Controller 1.0.51 (66)
- Smoother streaming and long-thread scrolling on Mac and iPhone, with less work as reasoning and tool output arrive. - Grok now keeps image attachments available for supported models and shows retry and automatic compaction notices. - Muse approvals now show each stage of a multi-stage request. - Worktrees recover from stale markers, stay available after archive and restore, and share one registry across development and production builds. - Memory consolidation works more reliably with ACP harnesses, and memory settings show readable tool summaries. - Connect recovers by replacing an address when its certificate order is stuck. - Android restores checkout controls for unsent drafts and fixes the Inbox dock staying hidden after glass customization.

## Controller 1.0.51
### Harnesses & Workspace - **Separate project and Mac pickers with a checkout tray.** The headline now has its own project and Mac pickers, and the composer gains a checkout and branch tray on Mac, iPhone, and Android. - **Instant remote new threads.** New threads on a paired Mac appear right away with an empty transcript while the Mac creates them in the background, and New Thread no longer fails when that Mac hasn't connected yet. - **More reliable Muse Code sessions.** Muse threads keep sending after a reconnect, harness restart, or host exit, and keep their Controller tools when a session is detached and reattached. Muse Code now shows the Meta logo. - **OpenCode workspace recovery.** OpenCode sessions that move out of their thread's workspace are moved back automatically instead of failing to attach.
### Mac & iPhone - **Plan chip morph.** The composer's task plan chip now expands into its card with the same lens morph as the reasoning effort control, clipped cleanly inside the glass.
### Android - **Quieter Sea Glass chrome.** Headers, docks, and buttons use calmer glass with crisp edges and a fine grain, and dark glass now etches light text and icons into the surface. - **Calmer sheets and switches.** Grouped sheet rows use a subtle tinted fill instead of a bright white card, switches rest on neutral glass when off, and Seafoam text has more contrast.
